lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 001: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: US-R1-001 is a mechanical doc-only fix in src/supervisor/result.ts: three JSDoc field comments (workerReportPath, expectedStoryId, WorkerOutcome.storyId) that still described worker-report.json as a fallback were corrected to reflect the report-first (PRIMARY) behavior introduced in US-001. Runtime behavior is unchanged. One gotcha: BLOCKED_*/PRD_COMPLETE in a JSDoc block comment terminates the comment early via the */ sequence; replaced with BLOCKED_.../PRD_COMPLETE. All 1372 tests pass.
